peer_positioning.text: Flughafen Wien has the lowest net leverage in the airport group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}), at {{net_leverage@FY2024}} against a peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@2024}}.

It also leads the group on gross leverage ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@2024}}), interest coverage ({{interest_coverage.peer_rank@2024}}), FFO to debt ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@2024}}) and FCF to debt ({{fcf_to_debt.peer_rank@2024}}).

The EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} is in line with the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@2024}}, ranking {{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@2024}}, and capex intensity of {{capex_intensity@FY2024}} also matches the median.
Liquidity is the exception: cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}} ranks {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}, the weakest of the group.

snapshot.text: Flughafen Wien, the Vienna airport operator, ended FY2024 with revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} and an EBITDA margin broadly stable at {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, leaving the balance sheet in a net cash position.
Net leverage stayed flat at {{net_leverage@FY2024}}, with total debt unchanged at {{total_debt@FY2024}} while EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the weakest of the airport peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}).

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, the lowest of the airport peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@2024}}), leaving little headroom against revenue of {{revenue@FY2024}}.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median, and free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} as a result.
Traffic: traffic growth of {{traffic_growth@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{traffic_growth.peer_median@2024}}, ranking {{traffic_growth.peer_rank@2024}} in the group.
Revenue mix: the non-aeronautical share fell by {{non_aero_share.change@FY2024}} to {{non_aero_share@FY2024}}, so earnings depend more on regulated aeronautical charges.
